purpose: Teach: ニッチ/日本航空/アリーナ/ソフィア/釜山/ジャマイカ/ユニセフ/松竹

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニッチな趣味のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, I hear your dad's been sharing his interesting hobbies with you.
lines.style: Warm, gently amused observation. Soft attack. Knowing tone—she's noticed something charming about Ryosuke's enthusiasm. Unhurried pacing, as if turning over the detail fondly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが日本航空でお出張なさるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! Dad told me about his trip with Japan Airlines!
lines.style: Bright, jumping energy—Sho can't quite contain his excitement. Quick attack on the first word. Words tumble forward. Small-boy enthusiastic but genuine, not performed. Eyes light up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアリーナコンサートに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to a concert at the arena, isn't he?
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Soft, wondering—like she's piecing together how thoughtful Ryosuke is being. Slight lift at the end. Tender and a little envious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとソフィアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! Dad and I looked at the Sofia picture book together!
lines.style: Eager and proud—Sho's sharing something that mattered. Quick, bright delivery. Seeking Mei's approval. Small but genuine laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが釜山に出張されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's being sent to Busan for work, I heard.
lines.style: Soft, almost reflective—Mei's noting it as another adventure in Ryosuke's world. Calm, unhurried. A slight wistfulness, like she's thinking about all the places he gets to go.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジャマイカの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! Dad and I looked at the Jamaica picture book!
lines.style: Same bright eagerness as before, but with a slight deepening—Sho's sharing multiple treasures. Quick, almost staccato bursts of joy. Wanting her to see how much he and Dad do together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがユニセフ募金箱を持って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a UNICEF donation box.
lines.style: Gentle surprise and warmth. Slight emphasis on 「brought」—noticing the kindness of it. Slow, thoughtful pace. A smile in the voice, like she's seeing Ryosuke's character through these small gestures.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと松竹の映画館行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis! I want to go to the Shochiku cinema with Dad!
lines.style: Direct want-statement. Eager but grounded—not demanding, just hoping. Quick but earnest. The close of the conversation: Sho's shared enough, now he's asking. Gentle but clear.
